findings.comment: Adjacent land uses are not documented for all surrounding properties. North boundary shows only zoning label (MF-4-CO) without land use description. South boundary shows property name (William John Tinnin, Jr.) without identification of the land use type (residential, commercial, vacant, etc.). East boundary correctly identifies Chateaux Ridge Condominiums/existing apartment buildings. West boundary (Valley View Road right-of-way) is appropriately identified as street.

applicableAreas: West side of site across Valley View Road right-of-way
findings.comment: Adjacent land uses for properties across the adjacent right-of-way (Valley View Road on west boundary) are not shown on the site plan. Properties across the street should be identified and their land uses documented.

Adjacent property zoning designations are not shown for all boundaries. East and North boundaries have zoning labels (MF-2-CO and MF-4-CO respectively). South and West (across right-of-way) boundaries lack zoning district designations. All adjacent zoning must be clearly labeled on the site plan.

Adjacent zoning designations shown on site plan (MF-2-CO, MF-4-CO) cannot be verified as accurate and consistent with current City of Austin GIS zoning records. This verification requires comparison with official GIS records, which are not available in the site plan documents.

applicableAreas: Multiple zoning districts abut the site (MF-2-CO, MF-4-CO, SF-3, MF-3, GO)
findings.comment: Zoning district boundary lines are not shown or labeled on the site plan where the site is subject to or abuts multiple zoning districts. The plan shows adjacent zoning labels but does not depict the boundaries between MF-2 (subject site) and the various adjacent districts (MF-2-CO, MF-4-CO, SF-3, MF-3, GO). Specific sheet references where each zoning boundary is depicted must be identified.

Zoning designations on mylars cannot be verified. Signed and sealed mylar sheets are not clearly provided in the submitted site plan documents reviewed. Confirm whether mylars are included in the application and, if so, verify that zoning designations are shown and match digital sheet designations.

The required note 'no buildings exist on adjoining lots within 50 feet' is absent from the site plan for the North and South property boundaries. Although no building footprints are shown on these boundaries within 50 feet, the absence of buildings should be explicitly documented with this note to confirm the site survey and demonstrate compliance with documentation requirements.

applicableAreas: Property connections to adjacent lots; parking areas adjacent to principal street
findings.comment: Property connections to adjacent lots are not identified and called out on the site plan. The triggering condition for this requirement is met: parking (88 spaces total including 10 surface spaces) is located between the buildings and the principal street (Valley View Road, west boundary). Per LDC Subchapter E § 2.3.1.A, private drive connections or public street connections to existing drives/streets on adjacent sites, or stub-outs if connections are not feasible, must be shown and identified on the site plan.

documentReferences.label: Sheet 1 - Cover Sheet; Sheet 9 - Site Plan

findings.comment: Article 10 compatibility applicability is not confirmed or documented on the site plan. Although the site is zoned MF-2 (which exempts it from Article 10 per § 25-2-1051), an adjacent triggering property exists (SF-3 parcel per facts.md). The applicant must document on the site plan or compatibility exhibit whether Article 10 applies, confirming site zoning and proximity analysis, and identifying any applicable exceptions under § 25-2-1052.

applicableAreas: Surface parking on south and west boundaries
findings.comment: Off-street parking of more than 10 spaces in residential district (MF-2) adjoining other residential-district properties must be screened by a wall, fence, or landscape screen at least 6 feet in height. While the site plan shows retaining walls on the south boundary behind parking spaces, the heights of these walls are not documented on the main site plan. Wall details and heights must be verified on detail sheets or specified to confirm compliance with the 6-foot minimum screening height requirement.

applicableAreas: All exterior lighting locations above second floor facing adjacent residential properties
findings.comment: No photometric or lighting plan is provided that shows fixture locations and heights. The General Site Plan Notes requirement prohibits exterior lighting above the second floor in locations facing or adjacent to residential property. The site is adjacent to residential-zoned properties (MF-2-CO, MF-4-CO, MF-3). Without a lighting plan documenting fixture locations and building heights, compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Mechanical equipment locations adjacent to residential properties
findings.comment: No mechanical equipment schedule or specifications are provided documenting equipment noise levels. The General Site Plan Notes requirement specifies that mechanical equipment may not produce sound exceeding 70 dB(A) at the property line adjacent to residential uses. The site is adjacent to residential properties. Provide an equipment schedule with manufacturer noise ratings (in dB(A)) at the relevant property line distances.
